findings.evidenceJa: 三半規管が大パニック
findings.governingReading: The volume throws Shirou’s semicircular canals, and thus his balance, into chaos.
findings.explanation: The English names the ear canals instead of the balance organs, weakening why his legs give out.

findings.governingReading: Saber defines Shirou’s only “finishing sword” as the judgment needed to steer the battle toward a situation where he need not fight.
findings.explanation: “Enough judgment” treats discernment as a quantity and reduces shaping the whole battle to stopping himself.
